revision, not every HTTP call.

mappings.source_obligation_text:

mailbox using the qualified safe-link/code issuance, unless a current proof is
explicitly qualified for the principal, exact mailbox revision, request, purpose

mappings.source_obligation_text:
Mailbox confirmation is evidence of control of that mailbox. It proves neither
legal identity, exclusive human ownership, representation, signature, document
authenticity nor business acceptance, and is not represented as MFA,
phishing-resistant authentication or a NIST assurance level. Source-required
stronger proof remains mandatory. Source-owned correction, representation and
lost-inbox recovery preserve attribution and cannot bypass proof.

mappings.source_obligation_text:

including finalization, processing promotion, result recovery and any separately
admitted read. Revocation/expiry/supersession fences new affected participant
authority and unaccepted late submissions. Durably received intake may continue
independently authorized source scanning, review or retention after a browser
session ends, without restoring participant access. Source withdrawal fences
promotion where its contract requires it. Ending access does not erase retained
evidence or recall already delivered copies.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C05 Proof and reuse | Invitation is insufficient. Fresh proof is delivered only to the fixed current source-approved address after deliberate eligible action. mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C06 Doorway and session | Reuse ADR-0025/0037 selector-plus-fragment transport and deliberate protected POST. GET/HEAD, passive scanner visits and prefetch create no authorized session or send. The doorway is scanner-resistant, not scanner-proof: an advanced scanner can submit forms, and an exchange never proves a human actor. Initial landing state is non-authorizing. Preserve the exact frozen qualified Tenant Donor Portal Host and existing private headers; use only an explicitly qualified same-tenant continuation to the existing participant surface. No credential-bearing redirect or cross-host Domain cookie.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C07 Action separation | Authorize instructions, initiate transfer, finalize, see status, preview, original download, replace and review separately. Upload permission supplies no directory, previous-submission, other-recipient, CRM, count/search or broader file read. A clean scan or confirmed recipient cannot accept evidence, complete a business requirement or sign anything.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C08 Recipient correction | The source alone changes intended recipient or materially changes request instructions through a versioned successor. Fence obsolete proofs/grants and pending promotion, preserve attribution and accepted evidence. Do not transfer previous-submission access to a replacement recipient by default. Same address after a change is not the same revision.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C09 Recovery and representation | Offer wrong-account switch, governed resend and source-owned correction/recovery. A user cannot type a replacement destination into the verification screen. Staff cannot set a verified flag or request the recipient's secret. Authorized helpers/representatives require existing source authority and separate actor attribution; Q01 neither universally permits nor bans shared mailboxes. A source without a qualified recipient/assurance policy cannot activate that purpose.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C10 Persistence and authorization | Derive actor, tenant, source and admission from trusted server context and current authoritative records. Use opaque identities, non-null required scope, same-tenant/source foreign-key relationships, unique logical operations, and immutable recipient/request/byte references where issued. Prevent changing authority-bearing columns through general updates. RLS/grants/command validation must agree on old and new row states and actual execution roles; privileged workers re-prove their narrowly delegated source authority.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C11 Retry and races | Consume the exact request-bound proof application/redemption and create/recover its one admitted result through an atomic authoritative command or equivalently proved recoverable owner protocol. Separately qualified reuse of parent native proof still requires a new independently authorized request binding. Scope idempotency to the intended effect and semantic fingerprint; same key/different intent conflicts. Co-commit local facts and required outbox work. Handle provider success/response loss as unknown until reconciled; never manufacture a fresh-key resend to hide uncertainty. Link/code siblings cannot both independently redeem.
mappings.reason: Source-specific observable outcomes and the named common invariants jointly cover this exact source context; all unique source conditions remain in the full owning contract.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C12 Currentness and clocks | Recheck current actor/service identity and operation-appropriate source authority at every protected operation. Participant actions and reads additionally require their current exact recipient/request admission; independently admitted worker processing re-proves its own source/worker authorization and withdrawal fences, not the former browser session. Apply these checks to finalization, promotion, full/range/conditional reads and recovered results as appropriate. Keep request due date, invitation expiry, proof expiry, session expiry, upload-grant expiry and byte retention distinct. Use server time and exact qualified profiles; neither reads nor resend renew the business deadline. Define the atomic admission point for revocation races.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q01-C13 Private custody | Transfer only into server-reserved private staging through a finite purpose-bound grant. Transfers not durably received before their admission ends stay unavailable and follow owner cleanup/hold policy; late scan success cannot revive revoked source authority. Durably received intake can continue independently authorized source processing after browser-session expiry, without granting new participant access.

mappings.source_obligation_text:

focus, readable statuses, contrast, narrow-screen reflow, touch, reduced motion,
localized names/dates/zones and slow/reordered responses. Do not rely on color,
hover-only details, disappearing toast or countdown chatter for essential

ratified later periods, include one visible optional recipient-email choice in
the existing meaningful staff review. In each genuinely new review initialize
it selected only when the exact source, actor, intended recipient, Live message
contract, effective Delivery Plan and channel path permit it. Staff can turn it
off. Clearly show the permitted recipient/destination and whether the final
action grants with this access notice or grants only. Preserve the choice
through validation and safe recovery; absent/legacy/conflicting input cannot
become true.

after defaults/plans/readiness change; true already authorized may recover its

mappings.source_obligation_text:

remains uncertain. Show the grant result and this notice's actual state in the
existing context. “Not requested” applies to the staff-off choice for this notice. A selected
notice that is blocked, suppressed, non-applicable or unresolved retains its
requested choice; a zero-child result does not rewrite it. Queued or accepted
does not mean delivered/read. Known unavailable or uncertain paths
must be explained safely, with a deliberate lawful grant-only choice where
permitted. Material change before admission must not silently downgrade a
confirmed combined intent. Selection, queueing, sending, opening and recovery
never reset the issued end or earlier limits.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q20-C01 — Scope and retained choice | Apply this optional email choice only to the ordinary native fresh unfinished and fresh completed-read source actions, first or subsequent periods. Keep their purposes distinct. For each genuinely new, known-eligible review initialize the visible choice selected; preserve the actual choice through validation, back navigation and safe draft recovery. Default initialization is not server authorization. Require an explicit valid reviewed choice under the command contract; missing, null, legacy or conflicting values must not default to true. A selected control need not be manually toggled to authorize its visible consequence at deliberate approval. Exclude original invitations, identity messages, reminders, review/fulfillment notices, bulk, other channels, staff alerts and specialist mandatory notices.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q20-C02 — Authority and eligibility | Treat the choice as a source occurrence condition, never as a per-grant Delivery Plan override, recipient preference, message classification or access permission. Derive tenant/environment, actor, grant/source, intended recipient/address revision, permission and audit attribution from trusted context and qualified owner relationships. The exact Live contract, effective bounded plan, audience, recipient eligibility/suppression, sender/reply and source/action checks must permit the notice. Known unavailable/unknown paths must be explained safely; staff can deliberately choose an otherwise-lawful grant-only path. Do not silently downgrade a confirmed combined intent before admission if material eligibility/destination changes. A provider delay with a valid durable authorized path is distinct from missing authority. After known source commitment preserve that result and report the actual notice state. mappings.source_obligation_text: Q20-C03 — Durable effect and exact replay | Preserve the committed grant, explicit reviewed choice and required communication handoff/recovery evidence coherently at the existing authoritative boundary before claiming the combined operation accepted. No notice can describe an uncommitted grant; a crash between source write and secondary processing must be recoverable from durable exact source evidence. Providers run outside database locks. Recover matching committed work before evaluating new admission. A replay with false must not add a notice after plan/default/readiness changes; changed true/false or other material under a committed identity conflicts. Recovery may complete the already-authorized true notice under its original meaning. P6 exact-set release includes valid zero-member results; unknown compilation is not a valid omission. No replay may append an omitted member. Use permanent source/purpose/recipient communication identity and material equality; do not mistake a transport request key for the business effect.
mappings.reason: Source-specific observable outcomes and the named common invariants jointly cover this exact source context; all unique source conditions remain in the full owning contract.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q20-C04 — Current source and immutable recovery | Keep all access clocks anchored to their ratified source issuance, with earlier limits; selection, queueing, delivery, opening and credential repair never reset them. Recheck exact source/grant/recipient/contact revision, plan/suppression, sender/reply/connection and protected-action applicability at the governing preparation/submission/use boundaries. A queued unfinished notice after fulfillment needs an exact qualified source/contract applicability or variant; otherwise do not dispatch it. Never rewrite a sealed unfinished notice into completed-read mail. Expired/revoked/no-longer-applicable work cannot advertise current access merely because it was selected earlier. Material changes use only authorized immutable recovery. A new credential, where allowed by ADR-0025, has its required new communication/prepared identity and recovery lineage without a new grant or clock. Old credentials do not resolve authority by finding the newest period.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q20-C05 — Provider truth and safe evidence | Reuse P6/ADR-0032's sealed payload, exact envelope, account/environment identity, bounded same-key recovery and reconciliation rules. The provider's 24-hour deduplication window is not Core's business-history TTL or permission to replay with a new key. Possible submission remains indeterminate until exact evidence resolves it; no blind resend, changed envelope, physical exactly-once promise or guaranteed recall. Authenticate callbacks and correlate them against the durable exact provider account/connection/environment/message/attempt; payload tags, address and signed metadata alone are not tenant authority. Duplicate/out-of-order events must not rewind delivery truth or confuse engagement with receipt/reading. Retain only approved body-free evidence; never raw protected URLs, credential verifiers, secret-bearing click payloads or private document facts in logs/history/queues.

mappings.source_obligation_text: Q20-C06 — One clear, accessible interaction | Reuse the existing source review and supported shared controls. Show the permitted recipient/destination and selected consequence in ordinary readable content, with a final action whose visible and accessible names accurately distinguish grant-plus-email from grant-only. Checkbox changes alone have no grant/send/navigation effect. Preserve state/focus, keyboard/touch/reflow, approved locale/direction and actual localized end with time-zone context; avoid countdown-only or transient-only results. For selected notices, preserve requested intent and report the actual blocked/suppressed/non-applicable/unknown outcome; a zero-child result does not rewrite the choice. Queued/accepted is not delivered/read; possible submission is not definitely not sent. Explain safe next action in context. mappings.source_obligation_text:
- **C01:** apply the prospective predicate to first original ordinary source
  issuance, including unissued existing drafts. Cover actual declared review
  scopes without requiring one person to cover everything, redundant staffing
  or per-item assignment UI. Do not silently gate existing intake or fresh access.
- **C02:** reuse source resolution and separate issuer, administration, target
  and later reviewer rights. A source may provide minimal eligible team-path
  evidence without copying/disclosing a roster or impersonating a reviewer.
  A witness change within a still-qualified team is not personal reassignment.
  Preserve deliberate named targets and all existing supported NHI owner/ceiling
  rules; introduce no automation lane, future-file grant or online/SLA requirement.
- **C03:** enforce through the actual source command across supported paths,
  using current relevant facts after waits. Preserve coherent source admission,
  mandatory history, minimal basis and durable handoff, with atomic co-located
  facts/outbox and providers outside locks. Prove material races without global
  roster locking or pointless re-confirmation. Genuine authorized source edits
  retain their own versions/consequences and recompute actual declared coverage;
  no silent lowering of protected requirements to bypass readiness.
- **C04:** recover original committed success under current disclosure before
  applying a new-issuance gate. Keep material user intent distinct from resolved
  witness and generated occurrence/end. Reconcile unknown effects, reject real
  intent conflicts, prevent concurrent duplicate originals and stale projection
  regression, and retain known source success through ancillary failure.
- **C05:** make the valid default path require no extra step. Give actionable,
  audience-safe repair/service/permission/unknown-result states, preserve actual
  authorized saved work and focus, and provide capable help when the issuer
  cannot repair. Fixing readiness is not a standing auto-issue subscription.
  Qualify the composed Core keyboard/AT/mobile/locale/slow-network journey.
- **C06:** preserve actual original timing. Schedule-only preparation checks at
  later admission; issue-now/deliver-later retains its admitted clock. Existing
  scheduling contracts determine which occurred. Later staffing loss does not
  undo lawful admission, automatically stop independent intake, reset deadlines,
  unaccept evidence, add a completion hold or create renewed/fresh access.
- **C07:** prove stable tenant-aware relationships, original-effect uniqueness,
  valid states, trusted immutable admitted outputs, effective grants/RLS and
  all direct/privileged paths. Dynamic eligibility uses the qualified currentness
  boundary, not a portable ready flag. Minimize private provenance/logs and keep
  bounded indexed coverage/history/recovery under measured finite budgets and
  existing applicable P12 limits. No financial data/precision change follows.
- **C08:** qualify actual native roles, source/custody/task bindings, races,
  faults, replay, workload, composed journeys, mixed versions and restore.
  Preserve genuine old admissions without fabricated historical readiness;
  apply the gate to old drafts when newly issued after activation. Gate unsafe
  old writers, preserve later acts during stop/rollback and reconcile restored
  outward effects before resumption. Trace canonical owners and projections at
  the authorized publication stage. No readiness aggregate or whole-Studio gate.

mappings.source_obligation_text: For an eligible ordinary Private Document Request that needs a different intended person for continuing legitimate source work, provide a guided, linked replacement request. A predecessor already lawfully canceled may support Q34's independently authorized remedy when its actual cancellation and current replacement purpose are proved; a canceled status alone is insufficient. Actual fulfillment, a specialist source or an unrelated purpose does not enter this ordinary replacement path. Tenants allocate these actual capabilities through existing qualified source/P12 controls and preserve their legitimate narrower policies; staff can prepare now, save and resume, discard preparation, stop old access independently when authorized, or complete the qualified handoff.
